en.answer: In this case, you can activate the effect of <<16198>> by choosing one of the applicable effects among "● Hand", "● Deck", and "● Extra Deck".
en.question: If my opponent Special Summons monsters from the Hand, Deck, and Extra Deck at the same time, can I activate the effect of <<16198>>?
